aligned_transcript.text: Soon...millions of people will see me...
I'll tell them about you...and your father.
How good he was to us. Remember?
It's a reason to get up in the morning.
It's a reason to lose weight...
Why should I even make the bed or wash the dishes?
I do them, but why should I?
I got no one to...care for.
I like the way I feel.
I like thinking about the red dress...
...and the television, and you, and your father.
Now, when I get the sun, I smile.
Now that I'm straight, my business is going good...
I'll come. Me and Marion...we'll come for dinner.
I'll make you mushroom soup and a roast.
That sounds great, Ma...That sounds great.
I'll give you a call at the time, all right?
I'm glad you have a nice girl and your own business. I'm glad.
I gotta go Ma, I have an appointment in Manhattan in a little bit...
Ok, you still got your key?
